question: A water tank has the shape of a right-circular cone with its vertex down. The radius of the top is 15 ft and the height is 10 ft. Water is poured into the tank at a constant rate of $C$ cubic feet per second. Water leaks out from the bottom at a constant rate of one cubic foot per second. The value of $C$ for which the water level will be rising at the rate of four ft per second at the time point when the water is two ft deep, is given by
